cards.claimScope: John Gill's place and old-style date of birth, his parents' names, and his mother's maiden name.
cards.approvedParaphraseRu: Джон Гилл родился в Кеттеринге, Нортгемптоншир, 23 ноября 1697 года по старому стилю; его родителями были Эдвард Гилл и Элизабет, урождённая Уолкер.

source.edition: John Rippon, A Brief Memoir of the Life and Writings of the Late Rev. John Gill, D.D. (London: John Bennett, 1838)

pageImageReview.primaryImageFinding: The final paragraph on printed page 1 visibly states Kettering, Nov. 23 o.s. 1697, Edward Gill, Elizabeth, and Walker as her maiden name.
pageImageReview.contextImageFinding: Printed page 2 continues with the family's social and dissenting-congregation context; it does not alter the birth-and-parents statement.

transcription.text: The subject of this Memoir was born at Kettering, in Northamptonshire, Nov. 23, o. s. 1697, of amiable and serious parents, Edward Gill, and Elizabeth his wife, whose maiden name was Walker.

contextWindow.before: Rippon introduces the memoir's method and says it retains authentic documents and character evidence while rejecting what is superfluous.
contextWindow.after: The next printed page describes the parents' modest circumstances and Edward Gill's membership in the local dissenting congregation.

supports: mother: Elizabeth Gill, maiden name Walker
doesNotSupport: Edward Gill's later office as deacon
